tasks.spec:
You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. Do NOT run a formatter on YAML or markdown (run `uv run ruff format` on Python files you change). You own only data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml, tests/test_narration_safety.py and tests/test_knowledge_projection.py. Edit nothing else. No story nouns in engine code (you change no engine code).

Background: knowledge items have an optional `leak_terms` list (models.py KnowledgeDefinition; see docs/markdown-story-authoring.md). Absent means the item's leak vocabulary is its aliases plus its multi-word must_convey phrases; a list is the item's whole leak vocabulary. The narration scan (storygame/runtime/narration_safety.py) rejects narration containing a leak term of an unearned item. Two ordinary phrases still reject live narration: 'rescue efforts' (3C; alias of k_resolution_kristin_rescue) and 'security officer' (2A; a phrase of k_sl_2a_c_r1). The project owner decided 'rescue efforts' is ordinary wording; 'security officer' is an ordinary job title. They stay recall/delivery vocabulary; they stop being leak terms.

Change knowledge.yaml only, adding a `leak_terms:` field (write it in the same style as the existing leak_terms lists on k_sl_2c_d_r1) to two items, placed right after the item's must_convey or aliases lines, touching no other field:
 1. k_resolution_kristin_rescue: `leak_terms: [remaining detention sites]`.
 2. k_sl_2a_c_r1: leak_terms listing exactly this current guard set without 'security officer': cooling failure, cooling leak, cooling-system risk, cooling-water imbalance, corridor access, corridor entrance, facility supervisor, infrastructure access, inspection supervisor, restricted access, restricted corridor access, security supervisor, sensor fault, service-level shutdown, ventilation fault, ventilation monitor, ventilation warning, water system problem, water-pressure fault. (Keep the original capitalisation and spelling of each phrase as it appears in the item's aliases or must_convey; verify each listed phrase is a phrase of that item and report any that is not.)
Do not change statement, delivery_text, cue_text, action_evidence, must_convey, aliases, earn_when, requires, establishes or source on any item.

Tests. In tests/test_narration_safety.py add two ACCEPT cases to the style of the existing test_ordinary_scene_wording_is_not_a_leak (same state building: bootstrap RuntimeState from PACKAGE, set current_scene_id, set phase from the scene's metadata.freytag_phase, call state._assert_scene_entry_fact(scene)): scene '3C', command 'Support the independent rescue efforts.', narration 'Kristin joins the people organizing rescue efforts outside the gates.'; and scene '2A', command 'Examine the security checkpoint.', narration 'A security officer waves a line of staff through the checkpoint.'. Add one REJECT case proving the guard remains: scene '2A', narration 'The ventilation monitor shows a sensor fault in the cooling system.' must raise ProposalValidationError (if that sentence is accepted in the real engine, pick another sentence using 'sensor fault' or 'ventilation monitor' and say so in notes.md). If an ACCEPT case is rejected for another term, report that term in notes.md instead of weakening the test. In tests/test_knowledge_projection.py add assertions that leak_term_to_knowledge has no owners for 'rescue efforts' and 'security officer' while term_to_knowledge still has k_resolution_kristin_rescue and k_sl_2a_c_r1 respectively.

Run: `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q tests/test_narration_safety.py tests/test_knowledge_projection.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py` (if uv is unavailable use the repo .venv python with PYTHONPATH=.). Write ./notes.md with the exact lines changed, any phrase from the list that was not in the item, and test results.
tasks.verified: rescue efforts and security officer are no longer leak terms; other guards on both items kept; only leak_terms lines changed; suite and ruff pass
